propositions: Replace per-criterion LLM fan-out recovery (explosion from 1 run to 22+ runs, 440-request worst case, uncached full-context re-sends per criterion) with banked incremental verification: primary banks verdicts as it runs, successor runs process only unverified remainder in batches, deterministic fallback closes ticket with banked evidence if finalizer fails.

Criterion identity minted deterministically at run start (c<index>-<sha256(normalized text)[:8]>); bank stores criterion_id, verbatim text, evidence (capped 3000 chars with truncated flag), ticket/material/tree stamps; successor preflight re-resolves stamps and fails loud on mismatch.

Criteria-scaled primary step floor (lever 1): replace flat _VERIFY_MIN_STEPS=480 with verify_step_floor(c)=clamp(8c, 48, 480); grounds in diag_runaway_matrix data showing 8-criteria ticket receives ~10x needed budget, surplus spent on 77% re-read waste then caught by runaway guard; typical tickets converge without recovery.

Path-normalized read_file memo (lever 2): cache whole-file content once per path, serve all ranges from cache, each repeat carries graduated nudge; 48 re-reads on 11 files (77% waste) collapses to 11 reads.

Budget pool arithmetic keyed on criteria count c and resolved model class (standard=>8 crit/batch, frontier=>12, trivial=>8): N=ceil(verify_step_floor(c)/2); global_pool=multiplier×N (default 1.5); successor_pool=global-primary_spend; per-run allocation floor(pool/runs_remaining); batch-shrink re-plan when floor<2×batch_size; zero-progress stops recovery.

Deterministic fallback guarantees full-coverage verdict never verdict-less: if finalizer fails twice with non-empty bank, emit verdict with banked met flags + met=false unverified placeholders, marked finalizer=deterministic_fallback and certifiable=false on the signed gate (distinct from child_closure_findings).
